text: Ngile, also known as Daloka, Taloka, Darra, Masakin, Mesakin [a dialect], is a Niger-Congo unwritten language in the Talodi family spoken in the southern Nuba Mountains in the south of Sudan. It is 80% lexically similar with Dengebu, which is also spoken by the Mesakin people.
